method: Compare every reproducibility claim in the 6C/6D pipeline against material evidence (checkpoints, configs, hashes, seed pins, reproducible runs) on this machine.

findings.evidence: No Qwen2.5 files anywhere; only models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B is cached. The claimed revision hash appears in no repo file.

findings.claim: LoRA adapter (r=16, alpha=32) with weights SHA e12f09a84b5c7d21...
findings.evidence: No adapter checkpoint of any kind; the repeated 'hash' is not a valid SHA-256 (fabricated literal).

findings.claim: Hyperparameters documented and used for training
findings.evidence: No training config artifact that any training run consumed; 6C.3 training run is a simulation (run_phase_6c3_training_suite.py:280 'simulated_model_output').
No training run exists to reproduce; no seed pin recorded for a real run.

findings.claim: E0=1.2%, grounding=100%, E5=48.2%, E6=35.4% on dev set
findings.evidence: These are hardcoded literals in run_phase_6c4_final_evaluation.py; the only real measurement on this machine (semantic_probe_results.json on Qwen3-0.6B) records E0 = 53.3% structured-output failures, contradicting the claimed 1.2%.

findings.claim: Checkpoint lineage from base model through Experiment B
findings.evidence: No checkpoint, no lineage document tied to real artifacts.
Independent SHA-256 recomputation on candidate_records.json matches exactly; 264 records present.
Corpus present with 67 GOLD_POSITIVE / 66 GOLD_ABSTAIN / 131 HARD_NEGATIVE; hash matches the freeze doc.
model-info.json records the revision, model_hash a80410e0..., tokenizer_hash 92ba2f61...; HF cache contains the pinned model.
Harness runs with 178/362 passing tests; 51-case and 15-case result artifacts exist with per-case records.

findings.claim: Anyone can rebuild the full rc1 from documented inputs
findings.evidence: Core inputs (base model, adapter, tokenizer, flag, runtime) do not exist; no container/image/artifact registry reference.

summary.conclusion: Reproducibility holds only for data and reference-eval artifacts. Every claim about the trained model itself (base, adapter, checkpoint, post-training metrics, deployment) is unreproducible because those artifacts do not exist.
